snippet.title: Cryptical Path - Announcement Trailer | Consoles
snippet.description:
Build the Dungeon and Crawl it: Roguelike Cryptical Path coming to consoles ✨March 4th✨

About the Game
Build Your Path: Forge your path through meticulously chosen rooms, sculpting an adventure that reflects your distinctive style and strategy!

1000’s of Possibilities: A galore of room combinations ensure every run is as unique as you want. You are the Architect, afterall!

Fight Your Way Out: Enjoy fast-paced action in glorious 2,5D, defeat tough enemies, get upgrades, combine items and perks to optimize your runs and defeat those pesky bosses!

Unfold the Story: Unravel the mysteries of your creation and navigate a treacherous landscape, where every shadow conceals a potential threat, and every step forward brings you closer to the wrath of those you have condemned to an eternity of darkness.

Game Platforms: Nintendo Switch 1 and 2, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Xbox Series XS, Xbox One.
